_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

There’s no uncommitted diff on `master`, so this is a review of the active codebase — `functions/`, `assets/js/`, `scripts/`, and custom `layouts/`.

## P0 — Fix first

### 1. Search stacks keydown listeners on every keystroke
**Bug** · `assets/js/search.js`

Each call to `doSearch()` adds another `keydown` listener without removing the old one:

```230:232:assets/js/search.js
      searchInput.forEach((el) => {
        el.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
      });
```

After a few searches, arrow-key navigation fires multiple times and memory grows. Register once at init, or `removeEventListener` before re-attaching.

### 2. Global graph auto-enters fullscreen on load
**Performance / UX** · `assets/js/notes-graph.js`

```1456:1460:assets/js/notes-graph.js
    if (!isLocalGraph) {
      colors = readColors();
      syncCanvasSize();
      setPresentMode(true);
      return;
    }
```

`/notes/graph/` immediately reparents to `document.body`, runs the force layout, and starts PixiJS WebGL. Heavy on mobile. Call `boot()` for global graphs too; only enter present mode when the user clicks expand.

### 3. Search filter logic diverges from `search-core.js`
**Bug / maintainability** · `assets/js/search.js`

Section filtering at lines 157–180 uses regex and always checks `description`, `tags`, and `categories`. Display/ranking at lines 261–265 uses `filterAndSortSearchResults` with `searchOpts`. Results can appear in a section group but render empty, or rank differently than `scripts/test-search.mjs` expects. Replace the filter block with `searchIndex()` / `matchesSearch()` from `search-core.js`.

### 4. Graph edge build is O(n²)
**Performance** · `layouts/_partials/notes/graph-data.html`

Nested `range $from` × `range $to` with string scans per pair (~55k iterations at ~235 notes). Precompute a wikilink index (title/slug/alias → page), then scan each note’s `[[wikilinks]]` once.

---

## P1 — Security

| Issue | Location | Fix |
|-------|----------|-----|
| OAuth callback broadcasts to `*` | `functions/api/callback.js:23` | Use expected CMS origin from env, not `"*"` |
| OAuth `scope` passed through unchecked | `functions/api/auth.js:26–33` | Allowlist `repo`, `user`; reject others with 400 |
| Flashcard backs use `safeHTML` | `layouts/_partials/notes/flashcard.html:18` | Escape backs like fronts, or sanitize |
| Duplicated admin CSP string | `functions/admin/_middleware.js` + `static/_headers` | Single source of truth to prevent drift |

---

## P2 — Performance & correctness

| Issue | Location | Fix |
|-------|----------|-----|
| Force simulation O(n²) per frame | `notes-graph.js:877–900` | Spatial hash, or stop sim after settle |
| `pixi.js/unsafe-eval` import | `notes-graph.js:4` | Drop if WebGL-only graph works without it |
| `resolveToken()` probes DOM repeatedly | `notes-graph.js:208–217` | Cache colors until theme change |
| `defer` + `async` on same script | `layouts/_partials/essentials/script.html:47–52` | Pick one (`defer` for lazy bundle) |
| Trailing comma in `searchindex.json` | `layouts/_default/list.searchindex.json:58` | Track last *emitted* item, not last in slice |
| URL search param double-encoding | `assets/js/search.js:81–84` | Use decoded value for display; encode only for history |
| Windows Hugo `.zip` via `tar` | `scripts/ensureHugo.mjs:107–108` | Use `Expand-Archive` / `unzip` for `.zip` |

---

## P3 — Maintainability

- **`safeJS` on JSON embeds** — use plain `jsonify` inside `<script type="application/json">` (`graph.html`, `review.html`, etc.)
- **Duplicated `escapeHtml`** across 5 JS files — one shared helper
- **`search.js` inline template fallback** — require `#search-result-item-template` in layout and delete the fallback
- **`clearModules.js` regex-strips `go.mod`** — prefer `hugo mod tidy` or delete if vendoring makes it unnecessary
- **`graph.html` recomputes stats** that `graph-data.html` already computed — return counts from the partial

---

## What’s already solid

- CSP pipeline (`scripts/cspHashes.mjs` + `static/_headers`) is thoughtful and documented
- `scripts/test-search.mjs` gives real regression coverage
- `deferred-media.js` and `spawnUtil.mjs` / `deployBuild.mjs` are lean and clear
- Backlink snippets escape before `safeHTML`

---

## Suggested order

1. Search keydown leak — quick, user-visible win  
2. Disable auto-present on global graph  
3. Unify search on `search-core.js`  
4. Index-based graph edge build — biggest Hugo build-time win as the garden grows  
5. OAuth hardening + flashcard escaping  

Want me to start with the P0 search/graph fixes?
